about_short_description.short_description: Marn provides easy-to-use cloud POS solutions to clients who manage SMEs to get you all they want, to manage their store, and more.

product.name: Marn POS System
product.description: A cloud-based point of sale system that manages sales, payments, inventory, and employee performance with real-time reporting and multi-payment options.

product.name: Marn Light POS Device
product.description: A point of sale device that processes electronic payments, issues invoices, and manages sales reports, designed for various retail and service businesses.

product.name: Retail POS System
product.description: An integrated retail cashier system with high-definition screens, barcode scanning, and inventory linkage for efficient sales and stock management.

product.name: Customer Display System (CDS)
product.description: A customer-facing display that shows order details, supports barcode scanning, loyalty integration, and multiple payment methods.

product.name: Order Status Screen (Notifier)
product.description: A display system that informs customers about their order status and alerts kitchen staff to manage preparation times efficiently.

product.name: PaySync Payment Screen
product.description: A payment screen that connects the cashier system to payment devices via Bluetooth to speed up transactions and reduce errors.
